snippet.title: GameBuddies.io. 15 party games in your browser. Share a link, friends join from anywhere.
snippet.description:
Free party games for your friend group — right in the browser. Fibbage-style trivia, drawing chaos, hot potato chases, tier-list arguments, audio telephone, 10+ more. No accounts. No installs. Built-in video chat. Share a room code, your friends are in. Twitch Chat Integration in most games for streamers.
Play free: gamebuddies.io
